definitions.short: Ajalon , the name of five places in Palestine
definitions.full: H357. Ayyalon אַיָּלוֺן proper name, of a location ( Deer -field) Aijalon — ׳א Josh 10:12 8 t.; 1 city in Dan Josh 19:42 ; 21:24 (Levitical city) Judg 1:35 ; 1Sam 14:31 doubtless same; so 1Chr 6:54 (where Dan omitted); apparently later in Benjamin 8:13 ; 2Chr 11:10 ; 28:18 (see Be); אַיָּלוֺן עֵמֶק Josh 10:12 almost certainly named from same; = Epiph. Ἰαλω modern Jâlo Rob BR ii. 253 , Survey iii. 19. 2 city in Zebulun Judg 12:12 .
